semantics.identity: Caller-supplied numeric project/issue identity and canonical web URLs must match the selected native authority, including configured API/web origins and prefixes. Mutations use the numeric project route.
semantics.authentication: One explicitly selected existing-native environment/keyring identity for all reads and any mutation. No official profile, account-equivalence assumption, new store or credential export.
semantics.redirects: No redirects or automatic retries, including same-origin cross-path replay; shared productnative owns enforcement.
semantics.type: Create sends issue_type=issue and a nonblank description. No additional metadata fields. A missing, null or transformed response description cannot prove the requested content.
semantics.note: Plain non-system non-internal note. Exact direct-response target and content evidence, never latest-note searches.
semantics.state: Close/reopen transitions are temporarily unavailable: return unsupported with a refused receipt and zero mutation attempts. Already-matching bound state returns unchanged as a read-only preflight observation, never an atomic precondition or exclusive authorship claim. Existing content is not filtered or resubmitted.
semantics.quick_actions: Reject slash-leading description/comment lines before credential resolution, including lines in code fences.
semantics.normalization: Enforce original private-file bounds first. Strip surrounding ASCII space, tab, newline, carriage return, vertical tab and form feed from titles; preserve internal and Unicode whitespace. After quick-action checks, remove carriage returns and trailing ASCII whitespace from new descriptions/notes. Preserve leading/internal whitespace and Unicode spaces in bodies. Hash canonical request JSON and require exact response content. State hashes represent requested intent only; nothing is submitted.
semantics.temporary_parity_gaps: No close/reopen mutation dispatch and no title-only or normalized-blank creation. Blank descriptions, including whitespace-only content, return unsupported before credentials or HTTP. No filler, compensation, snapshot-based permission or quick-action authority; see review-blockers.md.
semantics.ambiguity: Unconfirmed create/note outcomes remain ambiguous without search or replay. Attempts count intended native transfers, not proof of transmission or provider application.
semantics.limits: Private title <=1024 bytes; body <=131072 bytes; each JSON response <=2097152 bytes; aggregate <=8388608 bytes. Preflight/mutation 10/20 seconds inside the 45-second operation lifetime. Fixed reads, no pagination.
semantics.platform_limit: Windows persisted-native-config/self-managed mapping behavior is unproven; this contract does not expand general Windows authentication support.
